one_liner: HubSpot is a customer platform connecting marketing, sales, service, and data tools with comprehensive REST APIs and MCP servers.
access_notes: Free API access is available out of the box with self-serve account creation and no credit card required.
verdict_reason: HubSpot provides fully documented REST APIs, official MCP servers, self-serve credentials, and a free permanent tier.

evidence.snippet: If you plan to distribute your app to multiple accounts (either through listing on the HubSpot Marketplace or by managing specific authorized accounts), your app must be built using OAuth authentication.
HubSpot offers two distinct MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers — one for connecting any MCP-compatible AI tool or agent to your CRM, and one for building on the HubSpot Developer Platform.
